author: aditsangani (AI-assisted)
summary: Add opt-in consented event logging with isolated PostgreSQL writer
details: Add a separate dashboard factory, operator consent/withdrawal/deletion controls, private receipt helper, minimal fixed event records, parameterized PostgreSQL/Tiger Data adapter and 24-hour expiry view/cleanup. A bounded spawned writer isolates database stalls; withdrawal stops new submissions even if deletion cannot queue. Existing backend/dashboard factories, device protocol, deployment and policy are unchanged. Live database setup, persisted retention/deletion and cloud TLS verification remain unverified.
validation: 18 new logging tests passed including privacy/auth, admitted frame/vision output, parameter binding, deletion ordering/failure receipts and actual blocked-worker isolation/shutdown; 35 dashboard tests passed before the final added integration case. Checked publishing runs full shared tests and repository/log/whitespace checks. No live DB or hardware results claimed.
